bodyHtml:
AHR Expo 2020｜Aquasky

The AHR Expo is the world’s largest HVACR event, which attracts industry professionals from around the world each year. The Show provides an opportunity for manufacturers of all sizes and specialties to come together to share ideas and showcase the future of HVACR technology under one roof. You’ll have approaches to it all, from complete systems engineered for large commercial and industrial buildings to labor-saving tools and profit-generating services for residential contractors. 

Aquasky partner, Duratrac Product’s Booth Number: 5792
